governing_spec.section: Residual F07: Packaged Journal Owner and Durable Backend Configuration

defects_addressed.description: services/governance/decision_journal.py:551-554 resolved postgres backend via resolve_decision_journal_backend() but then delegated to build_governance_record_store() which independently re-read GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND and defaulted to json. Reproduced: isolated env with only DATABASE_URL, only GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN, or AGORA_GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND=postgres plus AGORA_GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN resulted in JsonGovernanceRecordStore.
defects_addressed.fix: _build_journal_record_store now accepts explicit backend/dsn/bootstrap parameters from build_decision_journal_stores which resolves once and propagates. PostgresGovernanceRecordStore is constructed directly with pre-resolved DSN; build_governance_record_store is not delegated to for postgres. CoordinatingJsonGovernanceRecordStore is still used for json backend.

defects_addressed.description: main.py:7749-7752 checked router.service but create_agora_router exposes router.agora_service; the attribute was never found so the injected owner was never wired. core/app_factory.py:1578 compose_bff_app did not pass app_deps.decision_journal_write_owner to create_agora_router, so the factory always built a new default owner. Reproduced: compose_bff_app(app_deps=AppDependencies.create_default(decision_journal_write_owner=injected)) had selected owner injected=False, selected path default-journal.
defects_addressed.fix: main.py attribute check corrected to 'agora_service'. create_agora_router call in app_factory.py now passes journal_write_owner=getattr(app_deps, 'decision_journal_write_owner', None).

defects_addressed.description: decision_journal_write_owner.py:79-95 is_storage_healthy checked only filesystem write-access via storage_path attribute. Postgres stores (PostgresGovernanceRecordStore) have no storage_path, so the check fell through to return True even when the DB was unreachable. Reproduced: GOVERNANCE_STORE_BOOTSTRAP=0 with localhost:1 target, list_all raised OperationalError, health still True.
defects_addressed.fix: is_storage_healthy now has two branches: (1) JSON stores: unchanged filesystem check via storage_path; (2) non-JSON stores (no storage_path): real connectivity probe via entries.list_all(); any exception maps to False.

defects_addressed.description: Prior evidence.json claimed 42+4+2+9=57 pytest tests, but reviewer-independent validation found 53 passed. Actual counts: test_decision_journal_write_owner.py=38, test_agora_write_owner.py=4, test_agora_decision_journal_patch.py=2, test_journal_runtime_contract.py=9. Evidence corrected and 3 new tests added to runtime contract file.
defects_addressed.fix: Evidence counts corrected per actual pytest --collect-only output. New tests bring total to 38+4+2+12=56.

compose_contract_alignment.details: docker-compose.yml and docker-compose.control.yml operator-bff service supplies GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND (${GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND:-postgres}), GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN (${GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN:-${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://...}}), GOVERNANCE_STORE_BOOTSTRAP (${GOVERNANCE_STORE_BOOTSTRAP:-1}), and PANTHEON_DECISION_JOURNAL_DATA_DIR. Preserves read-only /data/governance:ro volume mount. scripts/test_journal_compose_contract.py validates rendered config at exit 0.

backend_selection_and_legacy_reconciliat.details: resolve_decision_journal_backend() supports 'json' and 'postgres'. When GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND is unset, presence of DATABASE_URL or GOVERNANCE_STORE_DSN selects 'postgres'. Unsupported legacy aliases raise ValueError. Conflicting backends raise ValueError. Backend resolved once in build_decision_journal_stores and propagated through _build_journal_record_store without secondary env-read.

fail_closed_storage_honesty.details: JSON stores: CoordinatingJsonGovernanceRecordStore write operations fail closed with PermissionError on read-only mounts. Postgres stores: is_storage_healthy probes via list_all(); any OperationalError or connection failure returns False. Both storage types checked by tests.

bff_composition_root_wiring.details: AppDependencies.create_default() accepts and validates decision_journal_write_owner. app_factory.py create_agora_router call now passes journal_write_owner=getattr(app_deps, 'decision_journal_write_owner', None). main.py corrected to check router.agora_service (not router.service). Injected owner propagates through the real factory and is observable at agora_service._get_journal_write_owner().

restart_parity_and_isolation.details: Fresh DecisionJournalOwnerAdapter on same data directory reads previously committed entries. Tenant, actor, idempotency, and CAS isolation preserved across restarts. Tests in test_decision_journal_write_owner.py and test_journal_runtime_contract.py cover these paths.
